font-family.$description: Font family for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

font-size.$description: Font size for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

font-weight.$description: Font weight for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

line-height.$description: Line height for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

letter-spacing.$description: Tracking for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

measure.$description: Maximum inline measure for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when a list follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by a list to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; documented compound pairs may intentionally use the tighter outgoing gap.

color.$description: Text color for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

font-style.$description: Font style for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

text-transform.$description: Text transform for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

text-align.$description: Text alignment for ordered and unordered lists in prose.

padding-inline-start.$description: Inline-start indentation for top-level prose lists.

nested-padding-inline-start.$description: Additional inline-start indentation for each nested prose list.

item-spacing.$description: Block spacing between sibling list items.

nested-spacing-before.$description: Block spacing before a list nested inside a list item.

nested-spacing-after.$description: Block spacing after a list nested inside a list item.

loose-item-spacing.$description: Block spacing between consecutive paragraphs inside a loose list item.

unordered-marker-type.$description: Default marker shape for top-level unordered prose lists.

ordered-marker-type.$description: Default marker system for top-level ordered prose lists.

nested-unordered-marker-type.$description: Default marker shape for nested unordered prose lists.

nested-ordered-marker-type.$description: Default marker system for nested ordered prose lists.

marker-position.$description: Whether prose list markers sit inside or outside the content box.

marker-color.$description: Marker color for ordered and unordered prose lists.
